$$\Lambda^+=(\lambda^+_d)\ \ \text{and}\ \ \Lambda^-=(\lambda^-_d)$$

\]
\[
\lambda_d^{\pm}=0\:,\ \ \text{if}\ d\geq  y 
\]

\[

\]
